description: This file contains the implementation of an Android Activity (ContentInfoActivity) that displays detailed content information using Jetpack Compose. It includes UI components such as text labels, metadata rows, badges, description, and a focusable action button row optimized for Android TV with custom focus handling and navigation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Main activity that sets up the content info screen using Jetpack Compose. Handles intent extras and initializes the ComposeView with the content info layout.

methods.name: ContentInfoActivity.onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity's onCreate method to set up the ComposeView with the ContentInfoScreen, passing in content parameters.

methods.name: ContentInfoScreen
methods.description: A composable function that builds the entire content info UI, including title, metadata, description, and actions, with custom focus interactions.

methods.name: MetaText
methods.description: A composable for rendering small text labels in the metadata row.

methods.name: MetaDivider
methods.description: A composable for rendering separator lines ('|') in the metadata row.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: A composable that displays a stylized badge with configurable background, text, size, and corner radius.

methods.name: FocusAwarePill
methods.description: A focus-sensitive pill-shaped button with an icon and optional label, handling focus visuals, scaling, and key events for TV navigation.
